maker: Kenrobotech Co., Ltd. (建ロボテック株式会社)
model: Transport Tomorobo (運搬トモロボ) TMT-A1
name: Kenrobotech Transport Tomorobo TMT-A1
summary: Small rail-guided towing robot for construction sites: two 28 kg units pull a cart with up to 500 kg of rebar, blocks, cement bags, timber or steel along light temporary truss rails laid across rough ground or decks. Made by the Japanese maker of the Tomorobo rebar-tying robot.

germany.statusNote: Offered in Japan by the maker on request (enquiry, web meeting, choice of units, period and carts, then a quote and on-site introduction). No sale, rental or partner outside Japan found.

specs.label: Size (L × W × H)
specs.conditions: length without detachable contact sensor; height incl. signal light
specs.quote: L76（脱着式接触センサー除く）W61　H38（パトライト含む）

specs.label: Working time
specs.conditions: about 8 h incl. loading stops; 5 h / about 6 km continuous; charging about 6 h
specs.quote: 実働約8時間以上を実現(連続5時間・約6㎞の稼働)

specs.label: Battery
specs.quote: リン酸鉄リチウムバッテリー

specs.label: Guidance
specs.value: runs on temporary truss rails laid in units of about 4 m
specs.quote: 軽量で強固なトラス形状仮設レール※は約4mのユニットを、並べてジョイントするだけで簡単に設置できます

specs.label: Loads
specs.value: rebar, blocks, cement bags, mixers, timber, steel (cart chosen per load)
specs.quote: 鉄筋、ブロック、セメント袋、ミキサー機、木材、鉄骨など

notes: Rough ground is handled only on its own temporary rails, which also bridge steps and openings (maker).
Splash-proof for use in light rain (maker); no IP rating given.
Stops at the rail ends and when bumper or contact sensors touch a person or obstacle; stops if it tips over.
carryPayloadKg is the towed load of two units; one unit is light enough for one person to carry and fits in a small car's boot.

Is it sold or only rented? A Kagawa start-up sheet (PDF, not read) is said to list rental only.
